   Subject: FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2026

   Dear Sir,

   The Board of Directors of Demo Industries Limited, in its meeting held on October 27, 2026,
   approved the un-audited unconsolidated financial statements of the Company for the quarter ended
   September 30, 2026. The results are as follows:

                                                  Sep 30, 2026       Sep 30, 2025
                                              (Rupees in '000)   (Rupees in '000)
   Sales                                            10,210,451          9,035,797
   Profit after taxation                               838,074            686,721
   Earnings per share (Rupees)                            3.35               2.75

   No dividend has been declared for the quarter.
